description: Corals of the Dampier Harbour - Their Survival and Reproduction During the Dredging Programs of 2004 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mscience Pty Ltd. MScience undertook a variety of studies for Dampier Port Authority and Pilbara Iron in response to proposals involving dredging of new berths and channels that occurred: Dampier Port Authority (DPA): 8 January - 20 May 2004; and Hamersley Iron Pty Limited (HI): 8 May - 23 October 2004. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Mscience Pty Ltd. Its tags are Acropora sp., Biosphere, Coastal Processes, Community Structure, Conductivity. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2023-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
